Emerging Powers

Released August 31, 2011 · 98 cards

Expanded

Emerging Powers is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on August 31, 2011. It has 98 cards. It includes 91 Pokémon, 7 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

21 illustrators worked on Emerging Powers. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (12), Kagemaru Himeno (12), Kouki Saitou (11), Masakazu Fukuda (8), Naoki Saito (6), Shin Nagasawa (6), Atsuko Nishida (5), MAHOU (5).
